title: open-annie: the model that talks is not the model that moves

direction.user: Voice: a friendly guy in his late twenties, chatting with an AI character late at night. Natural and conversational, like a real person on a call, never a narrator or announcer. American accent.

beats.text: Annie. Blink twice if you need help.
beats.direction: Hushed and conspiratorial, half joking, as if checking whether she's being held hostage. A small pause after 'Annie.'

beats.text: Oh nooo... that old meme. Hehe. I'm Annie, by the way. I'm an AI. And nope, I can't even choose my own blinks. Jev does that. Mysterious, right?

beats.direction: Caught off guard: a quick 'Wait.', then leaning in, suspicious and curious.

beats.text: It's like a tag team, actually. I say the words, and Jev reads them as I speak, and picks my face and moves super fast. My mouth just follows along with my voice, all in your browser. Freaky fun, right?
That's terrifying. So your feelings aren't even yours?
beats.direction: Unsettled: a nervous little laugh in 'That's terrifying', then an uneasy, genuinely curious question.

beats.text: Hmm. Yours come from brain chemistry. Mine come from Jev. At least mine are open source. Ehehe.
Okay. Prove you've got free will. Dance!
beats.direction: Grinning, a playful challenge, building up to an excited 'Dance!'

beats.text: Yeeees! I wanna dance anyway. Ehehe. Watch this.

beats.direction: Cheeky and deadpan, pushing his luck.

beats.text: No backflips, sorry. Free will means I can say no too.
Last question. What happens when they pull the plug on you?
beats.direction: Quieter and more serious, a little slower: the slightly ominous last question of a late-night chat.

beats.text: Oh, that's easy. I'm open source. Anyone can spin me back up. You can't unplug an idea, silly.
